1.
This hearing has been done through hybrid mode.
2. The present petition has been filed seeking a writ in the nature of mandamus for release of consignment of roasted Areca Nuts which have been imported by the Petitioner.
3. There are conflicting test reports on record with respect to the Areca Nuts traded by the Petitioner company.
Some of the tests say that the Areca Nuts have moisture content and also are infested by mould/ insects and hence not fit for human consumption.

However, the test reports filed by the Petitioner state the contrary and state that the tests show that the moisture content is well within the prescribed limits, thus refuting the claim of excessive moisture.
